::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/raw_export/{dataset}"}
#docs
Reconciling with the figure is the whole point, so the window is taken from the report layer's own bucket builder rather than re-derived from the range name — cut on a second calendar, an export would explain a number it does not equal. Σ `reporting_amount_minor` over the window equals the headline of the dataset's `reconciles_with` report, exactly, in integer minor units.

Every money column stays in the currency it was earned in, with `reporting_rate` and `reporting_amount_minor` beside it saying what conversion the report applied. Totals are offered PER CURRENCY and never across them: adding paise to cents produces a number that is true of nothing. A row in a currency no exchange rate reaches is left out, because the report leaves it out too.

`data` is an array of arrays positioned by `columns`, paged with the usual `limit`/`starting_after` cursor. `format=csv` streams the same rows a page at a time, so the response is bounded by a page rather than by the size of the tenant; an empty window still returns the header row, because a file with no header reads as a broken export rather than a quiet period.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `dataset` | `string` | **yes** | A dataset key from the export catalogue. |

## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `range` | `string` | no | The report preset whose window the rows are taken over. Default `12m`. |
| `currency` | `string` | no | Export in this currency only, and convert nothing — the counterpart of the same parameter on a report, so the two answer the same question. |
| `limit` | `integer` | no | Maximum number of rows to return. |
| `starting_after` | `string` | no | Opaque cursor from a previous next_cursor |
| `format` | `string` | no | `csv` streams every row in the window as a file, cursor and all. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `dataset` | `string` | The dataset's key. |
| `reconciles_with` | `string` | The report key whose headline these rows sum to. |
| `window_start` | `string · ISO-8601` | The start of the exported period (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `window_end` | `string · ISO-8601` | The end of the exported period (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `reporting_currency` | `string` | The currency the report converts to (ISO-4217 code). |
| `converted` | `boolean` | False when the caller scoped to one currency, so nothing was converted. |
| `totals_by_currency` | `array of object` | The window total per currency, in that currency. Deliberately never summed across them. |
| `columns` | `array of string` | The column names, in the order of each row's values. |
| `data` | `array of array of any` | One array per row, positioned by `columns`. |
| `has_more` | `boolean` | Whether more rows exist after this page. |
| `next_cursor` | `string` | Pass as `starting_after` to get the next page. Null on the last page. |
| `limit` | `integer` | The page size used. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |
| `400` | An unknown dataset or range, or a malformed cursor |
| `404` | No such business |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/raw_export/mrr_movements?limit=10" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
